comment: A press outside the Welcome window puts it away, as Blender's splash does. A capture run refuses the boot's window, so Help opens it, id 505 being help_menu.gd's own constant. A press on the window's own pane keeps it, a press on the canvas closes it, once with subwindows embedded and once with each window its own. The dump's windows array carries 'Welcome to Sara' and whether it is visible.
